messages:
maria: FYI monthly entitlement-report flagged 7 principals in prod with overlapping admin + read-only roles. looks like stale assignments creeping back in after the recert job runs.
leo: can you paste the report id?
maria: report://ent-2026-03-prod-07 (attached). quick peek shows a cluster of service principals with `admin` inherited via `legacy-role-alias`.
sam: legacy-role-alias? that's been deprecated since last year. should've been remapped to `svc-operator`.
ash: the recert job resolves aliases by calling role-resolver service which reads mapping from KMS secret `role-mapping/prod`. sec-bot: role-resolver invoked 2026-03-01T03:12Z -> secret version v12.
sec-bot: EntitlementScan: 7 anomalies found, severity: low-medium, details: duplicate-high-priv assignments, owners missing attestations >60d. link: /scans/ent-2026-03-prod-07
leo: guess: mapping drift — maybe role-mapping secret rotated back to an old version or the resolver fallback returned alias -> admin. can we confirm secret history?
ash: checking KMS history: `kms history role-mapping/prod` returns: v10 (2025-12-01), v11 (2026-02-20), v12 (2026-02-28), v11 (2026-03-01) <- rollback.
maria: rollback to v11 on 2026-03-01 at 03:11Z aligns with recert run. so the resolver likely read v11 which still had `legacy-role-alias: admin`.
sam: that's bad. Who triggered the KMS rollback? ops change log shows `ops:scheduled-secret-rollback` by leo at 2026-03-01T02:55Z to mitigate a transient deploy.
leo: that was to revert a broken mapping in staging, I didn't realize prod mapping would be affected. need to check our KMS promotion script.
oncall-sre: opened a temporary guard: `authz disable-alias-resolution --env prod` to stop automatic alias-to-admin resolution until we remediate.
maria: thanks. action plan suggestion: 1) run a least-privilege diff for affected principals 2) dry-run auto-demote to svc-operator (no user accounts) 3) notify listed owners to attest or respond 4) add a preflight check in the recert pipeline comparing deployed secret version vs expected in manifest.
sec-bot: LD-DIFF queued: job 90177 for principals [svc-pipeline, svc-cache, svc-metrics]. returns expected in ~15m.
sam: for safe-demote dry-run command: `rbac reconcile --mode dry-run --principals file://affected.json --map legacy-role-alias:svc-operator`
leo: run it and paste output. if it only touches service tokens, we can auto-apply with a 1hr rollback window.
oncall-sre: dry-run done: changes show 7 grants -> demote admin -> svc-operator on 7 service principals. no human users. checksum: `sha256:abc123`.
maria: schedule auto-apply at 10:30 UTC with a 1h monitoring hold. please capture audit evidence: policy, pre-change scan, post-change scan, and KMS secret version snapshots.
nash: will add `KMS_SECRET_VERSION` metadata to role-resolver logs and include the secret checksum in the entitlement record going forward. snippet I will add to resolver: `log.info("role-map-version", {"secret_version": v, "sha": sha256(rolemap)})`
leo: also add a lint in the recert pipeline: fail if secret version != manifest.expected_rolemap_version. that should prevent accidental rollbacks hitting prod.
maria: also, let's schedule a targeted owner attestation: owners listed in the report get 72h to respond, otherwise we auto-demote after 96h. record the policy in the security runbook.
sam: can we add a periodic query that flags when role aliases map to a higher tier than expected? useful for future periodic reviews.
oncall-sre: created alert rule: `alias-mapping-tier-check` -> fires when alias_tier_delta >= 1 for prod. routing: eng-security + oncall.
sec-bot: post-action checklist created: ticket SEC-4247 with owners: leo (change owner), maria (review owner), sam (automation), oncall-sre (ops).
maria: good. I'll update the monthly entitlement workflow to include KMS-version assertions and a weekly sweep to catch regressions. closing loop: run post-change EntitlementScan and attach to the ticket.
leo: sorry about the surprise rollback. I'll audit the KMS-promote tool and add a safety that prevents promoting older versions into prod without explicit approval.
maria: thanks. follow-up meeting optional: tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review runbook changes. :calendar:
